name: Titus Vindex (Capsarius)
notes: Field medic. Carries the capsa medical cylinder. Stabilizes wounded on the field.
gm_notes: NPC Capsarius. Works alongside Valeria in the hospital but operates in the field. In combat: stabilizes downed soldiers as a bonus action once per round (within 5 ft). In session notes: he was present during the excavation deaths. He filed the medical reports. DC 13 Medicine (discussing the deaths with him): his accounts are technically accurate but he avoided certain conclusions. Something was wrong with the bodies that he chose not to document.
